name: WARNING: Panera Mediterranean Warm Grain Bowl with Chicken
whyItWorks: Features 9g of coarse fiber from whole-grain brown rice and quinoa, topped with raw diced cucumbers, raw red onions, whole kalamata olives, garlic hummus, and Greek yogurt dressing. Rough seeds, skins, and garlic triggers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip grain bowls with whole quinoa and raw veggies. Order plain white sourdough sandwiches.
